sections.text: مقدمة

هذا 
 توضح الوثيقة فحص المعدات، الذي يجب إجراؤه على 
 القواعد السنوية كما هو موضح بواسطة Y1 في مقطع العنوان.

The purpose of this transmitter is to make a 
 matching of devices with pressure output to the normal voltage input of BBC 
 electronic devices. The converter sections are not insulated from one other.

This document initiated by eng. Mahmoud Saleh Ali, 
 tested by eng. Maher Abdel Gawad Salem and eng. Mohamed El-Sayed Ahmed, approved by eng.Mohamed Salah Eldin Abdel Ghafar 
 general director.

This document revised by eng. Nageh Soliman 
 Shousha: CEPC quality control director, and certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim 
 El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's Head Sector and MPIS coordinator.

Test 
 leads.

Air 
 Compressor
Pressure gauge indicator (0-15bar).
العمل الذي يتعين القيام به

Remove the cover 
 of the pressure transmitters.

Connect the test 
 leads at the pressure transmitters test jacks as shown in figure (1).

Inject for the 
 compressor at the both pressure transmitters direct pressure with a pressure 
 supply.

Measure the 
 injected compressor pressure by using the pressure gauge indicator.

Increase the 
 pressure from (6.11bar, 7ba, 8bar, 9bar, 10.19bar) and record the pressure 
 transmitters output (10-50 mv).

Compare 
 characteristic with final setting and measurement as shown in figure (2).
